## Appendix B: Consolidated Field Reference


This appendix consolidates all field description tables from across the documentation, grouped by sub-module. This provides a single reference for all field definitions.


### Framework - AU (AU)


**Misc**

| Field | Example value | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| @ID | SG0020100 | New business unit (lead company) code |
| Company Name | Singapore branch |  |
| Name Address | Singapore |  |
| Mnemonic | SGP | Mnemonic for this business unit (lead company) |
| Financial Com | SG0020100 | Financial code for this business |
| Financial Mne | SGP | Mnemonic for the business unit |
| Sub Division Code | 0100 | Subdivision code for the new company |
| Default Company | SG0020100 | Company code of the business unit to which the accounting unit belongs |
| Consolidation Mark | N |  |

**Misc**

| S.No. | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | AU.PARAMETER | This parameter defines the lead company and the accounting companies under it. A new DECOMMISSION.DATE field is introduced and the user can define a date in this field. Post the date, the system will not allow the accounting company to follow the AU rules. |


### Framework - BY (BY)


**Misc**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Validate Beneficiary Links | Indicates whether the BENEFICIARY.LINKS application must be checked while amending the account in BENEFICIARY or while reversing the record in BENEFICIARY . This file is updated by AA contracts, Standing Order and Payment Order when they are using a BENEFICIARY record. When this field is set to Yes (for the first time), the system starts the ST.BENEFICIARY.LINKS.UPDATE service to update the Beneficiary Links File upon authorisation of the application. |
| Update Acct Block Closure | Indicates whether the AC.BLOCK.CLOSURE application should be updated when the account is referred in a BENEFICIARY . During the closure of the account, the system raises an override to indicate the account is referred in one or multiple records in BENEFICIARY . When this field is set to Yes (for the first time), the system starts the ST.UPDATE.AC.BLOCK.CLOSURE service to update the Account Closure upon authorisation of the application. |


### Framework - DA (DA)


**Customer AccountBalanceReportingModel**

| Table Name | Table Description | Domain/Support Table | FACT/DIM | Corresponding Temenos Transact Table |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT | This table contains the movements that have affected an account, as a result of a completed transaction event. Every record occurrence in this table represents one movement that has affected the account balance | Domain | FACT | STMT.ENTRY / STMT.ENTRY.DETAIL |
| FACT_BALANCE | This table contains the after image of the balances of an account as a result of movement to that account, generated by an underlying transaction There are two types of balances recorded: Booking - Based on when the balance is reflected in the general ledger. Value - When the balance is used for interest calculation. Every record occurrence in this table represents the after image of the balance for an account with the corresponding balance type, balance date and timestamp at which the balance is updated | Domain | FACT | ACCT.ACTVITY / ACCT.BALANCE.ACTIVITY |
| DIM_ACCOUNT | This table contains the details for each ACCOUNT record. This could be a customer account, nostro/vostro, or an internal account. Each occurrence in this table represents the after image of any change in an account (creation, change or closure) | Domain | DIM | ACCOUNT |
| DIM_TRANSACTIONTYPE | This table contains the details of the transaction code as held in each occurrence of the FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT table | Domain | DIM | TRANSACTION |
| STATEMENT | This table contains the basic details of an account in a statement | Domain | DIM | ACCOUNT.STATEMENT |
| PARTY_RELATIONS_MASTER | This table contains the basic details of the customer relationship between Temenos Transact customers or Temenos Transact customer to person or an entity. Each occurrence defines a type of relationship | Domain | DIM | CUSTOMER.RELATIONSHIP |
| PARTY_RELATIONS_DETAIL | This table holds the details of each relationship type. These are the actual relation of the corresponding party and role | Domain | DIM | CUSTOMER / ACCOUNT / SEC.ACC.MASTER |
| DIM_PARTY | This table contains the customer details. Each occurrence of a record in this table is the after image of a change to a customer | Support | DIM | CUSTOMER |
| DIM_COMPANY | This table contains the details of each financial entity. Each occurrence holds the after image as a result of a change to the company detail | Support | DIM | COMPANY |
| DIM_OFFICER | This table contains the details of the authorised bank officers | Support | DIM | DEPT.ACCT.OFFICER |
| DIM_CURRENCY | This table contains the basic details of the currency definition | Support | DIM | CURRENCY |
| CURRENCY_DESCRIPTION | This table contains the basic details of the currency description | Support | Snowflake | N/A |
| DIM_CHANNEL | This table contains the basic details of the channels defined in the system | Support | DIM | EB.CHANNEL |
| CHANNEL_DESCRIPTION | This table is an extension of the CHANNEL table, as the description is multi-valued and language related | Support | Snowflake | EB.CHANNEL / LANGUAGE |
| BANKING_DATE | This table contains the system date of the financial entities within the database. Each occurrence is the after image, as a result of a change in the date for each financial entity | Support | DIM | DATES |
| LANGUAGE | This table contains the reference to the language codes available in the system and the corresponding description | Support | Reference | LANGUAGE |
| TARGET | This table contains the list of target codes defined and assigned to CUSTOMER records, to indicate how the customer fits in with the bank's overall marketing strategy | Support | DIM | TARGET |
| TARGET_DESCRIPTION | This table is an extension of the TARGET table, as the description is multi-value and language related. Each occurrence of the record is the language related description | Support | Snowflake | TARGET / LANGUAGE |
| CUSTOMER_STATUS | This table holds a list of customer status that may be assigned to CUSTOMER records, which allows the bank to classify their customers on any kind of criteria defined locally | Support | Reference | CUSTOMER.STATUS |
| CUSTOMER_STATUS_DESCRIPTION | This table is an extension of the CUSTOMER_STATUS, as the description is multi-value and language related | Support | Snowflake | CUSTOMER.STATUS / LANGUAGE |
| INDUSTRY | This table holds the list industry codes that may be assigned to each CUSTOMER record which identifies the industry in which the customer is trading | Support | DIM | INDUSTRY / LANGUAGE |
| INDUSTRY_NAME | This table is an extension of the INDUSTRY table which holds the description for each language defined | Support | Snowflake | INDUSTRY / LANGUAGE |
| SECTOR | This table holds the list of codes that may be assigned to each CUSTOMER record which identifies the economy segment in which the customer is trading | Support | DIM | SECTOR |
| SECTOR_DESCRIPTION | This table is an extension of the SECTOR table which holds the description for each language defined | Support | Snowflake | SECTOR / LANGUAGE |
| USER | This table holds the list of users that are allowed to access Temenos software | Support | Reference | USER |

**Customer AccountBalanceReportingModel**

| Views | Description |
|---|---|
| DF.VW.CUSTOMER | This view retrieves the details relating to the customer from the DIM_PARTY table, to allow customer search. |
| DF.VW.CUST.RELATION | This view retrieves the information relating to customer relationship from the DIM_PARTY, PARTY_RELATIONS_MASTER and PARTY_RELATIONS_DETAILS tables. |
| DF.VW.ACCOUNT | This view retrieves the details relating to account from the DIM_ACCOUNT table. |
| DF.VW.AC.STMT.SUMMA | This view retrieves the details relating to account and the statements from the DIM_ACCOUNT and STATEMENT table. |
| DF.VW.ACCOUNT.MOV | This view retrieves the details relating to value-dated account movements from FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT table. This provides few details. |
| DF.VW.ACCT.MOV.DTL | This view retrieves the details relating to account movements from FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT and DIM_ACCOUNT tables. This provides more details of the account movement. |
| DF.VW.AC.BOOKDT.BAL | This view retrieves the details relating to account booking dated balance from FACT_BALANCE (with balance type as BOOKING) and DIM_ACCOUNT tables. |
| DF.VW.AC.VALUDT.BAL | This view retrieves the details relating to account value dated balance from FACT_BALANCE (with balance type as VALUE) and DIM_ACCOUNT tables. |
| DF.VW.AC.BOOKDT.MOV | This view retrieves the details relating to the account movements, based on the processing date from the FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT and DIM_ACCOUNT tables. |
| DF.VW.AC.VALUDT.MOV | This view retrieves the details relating to the account movements, based on the processing date from the FACT_ACCOUNTMOVEMENT and DIM_ACCOUNT tables. |

**Customer AccountBalanceReportingModel**

| Description | Enquiry Name in Temenos Transact | Enquiry Properties | Metadata Definition used in Temenos Transact Enquiry |
|---|---|---|---|
| CUSTOMER search - Search for matching customers. | ENQ.DIM.CUSTOMER.SEARCH | This query allows the user to search for customers across the enterprise and provides summary information about the customer, including the company, name, type of customer and status. Search options based on partial addresses and names are provided. From this base query, a number of subsequent queries are run for each customer that is found. | DF_VW_CUSTOMER |
| Customer Relationship search - Search for related customers. | ENQ.DIM.CUS.REL.SEARCH | This query allows the user to search for related customers. For a specified customer, expressed either as a number or name, the query shows all the related customers and the nature of their relationship. The user can restrict the search to relationships of a specific type. Temenos Transact is restricted to define relationships between customers owned by the same entity and only where the customer table is shared. | DF_VW_CUST_RELATION |
| Account search - Search for matching accounts. | ENQ.DIM.ACCOUNT.SEARCH | This query allows the user to search for accounts across the company. The user can search for a specific account matching the account number (including external account numbers) or the account title. The user can search for accounts owned by a customer, with optional additional criteria such as product and currency. As a result the query presents a list of all accounts found. | DF_VW_ACCOUNT |
| Account Statement summary - Shows the account statement dates and the opening and closing balances for matching accounts. | ENQ.DIM.ACC.STMT.SUM | This query is provided to show dates on which an account has produced an account statement, and the closing balance that is shown in the statement. The user can select accounts either based on a specific account number or for a specified customer criteria, in which case multiple accounts are shown. The search can be narrowed by supplying a range of dates to be considered. | DF_VW_AC_STMT_SUMMA |
| Account Movement search - Search for specific movements over specified accounts/customer and time. | ENQ.DIM.ACC.MOVEMENT | This query allows the user to search for specific movements that were posted to a Temenos Transact account. The search criteria allows the user to search across multiple accounts, and the user can refine the search by specifying the details of the customer and currency of the account. Search capability is possible using the details provided in the accounting entry such as, amount, local amount, type of movement, quoted reference and narrative information. | DF_VW_ACCOUNT_MOV DF_VW_ACCT_MOV_DTL |
| Account Booking dated balance - Shows the booking-dated balance for account(s) over a specified period. | ENQ.DIM.ACC.BKDATED.BALANCE | This query shows the booking dated balance for an account on any specified date or range of dates. The user can search for one or more accounts, either by a specified ID, account title, customer name or number. A date is specified and the booking-dated account balance on that date (or the last movement date before that date) is shown for the requested period. The booking-dated balance is the balance that the account holder is shown in their account statement. It is updated on the processing date of an underlying account movement. | DF_VW_AC_BOOKDT_BAL |
| Account Value dated balance - Show value dated balances for account(s) over a specified period. | ENQ.DIM.ACC.VDDATED.BALANCE | This query shows the value-dated balance for an account on a specified date or range of dates. The user can search for one of more accounts, either by specified account, account title or customer name or number. A date must be specified and the value-dated account balance on that date (or the last movement date before that date) will be shown for the requested period. The value-dated balance is the balance that is the basis for all interest calculations on an account. It is updated using the value date of an underlying account movement. | DF_VW_VALUDT_BAL |
| Account Statement - Show open and closing booking dated balance and movement details for an account over a specified period. | Composite screen: DIM.ACCOUNT.STATEMENT Enquiries: ENQ.DIM.ACCOUNT.STATEMENT | The query provides complete details of movements across an account or accounts between specified dates, showing the booking-dated balance on the start date and the end date. Details of the movement include the movement amount, value date, transaction with other references and the transaction narrative. Full movement details and the underlying common transaction information are available, allowing customised views with the different types of detail to be included. The query allows selection of multiple accounts for one or more customers in different companies. | DF_VW_AC_STMT_SUMMA DF_VW_AC_BOOKDT_BAL DF_VW_ACCOUNT_MOV |
| Account Value dated statement - Show open and closing value date balance and movement details for an account over a specified period. | ENQ.DIM.VDATED.STATEMENT | The query provides full details of movements across an account or accounts between specified value dates, showing the value-dated balance on the start date and on the end date. Details of each movement shown include the movement amount, the processing date, the transaction and other references and the transaction narrative. Full movement details and the underlying common transaction information are available, allowing customised views with different amount of detail to be included. The query allows the selection of multiple accounts for one or more customers in different companies. | DF_VW_AC_STMT_SUMMA DF_VW_AC_VALUDT_BAL DF_VW_ACCOUNT_MOV |

### Framework - EU (EU)


**Displaying Euro Equivalents**

| Input | Amount fields |
|---|---|
| Format | UTIL FIXEQU, ccy name Where, Ccy name is the name of the enquiry field containing the value of the currency. |
| Result | If Ccy name is an In-currency, the Euro Equivalent calculated at FIXED.RATE. If Ccy name is an out currency, a null value is returned. |

**Displaying Euro Equivalents**

| Input | Amount field |
|---|---|
| Format | FIXEQU*ccy name Where, Ccy name is the name of the De Message field containing the value of the currency. |
| Result | If Ccy name is an In-currency, the Euro Equivalent calculated at FIXED.RATE. If Ccy name is an Out-currency, a null value is returned. |

**Misc**

| Term | Description |
|---|---|
| Article 235 | The council regulation (EC), which governs conversion and rounding rules for euro conversion. |
| EMU | European Monetary Union. |
| NCU | National Currency Unit – a general term for existing national currencies. |
| In-currency | A currency that is converting to EUR. |
| Out-currency | A currency that is not a member of EMU. |
| Triangulation | The process of converting one In-currency amount to another through the euro. |
| Re-denomination | Process of converting an In-currency transaction to the euro equivalent of something, which is at the fixed conversion rate. |
| Transition Phase | The phase where both NCU and EUR can be used. ERI (Euro Related Information) is added to SWIFT messages where the amount is converted from NCU to EUR. |

**Misc**

| S.No. | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | COUNTRY | This application allows the user to define the code EU as Euro need its own country code. In addition, Geographical Block field must be defined from the available dropdown geographies. |
| 2. | CURRENCY | This application allows the user to define the currency record for EUR. In addition, user must ensure that correct quotation code is defined. User must not define Fixed Ccy , Fixed Rate and Fixed Start Date for EUR Currency. |
| 3. | CURRENCY.PARAM | This application allows the user to define the common characteristics of Euro. In addition, Base CCY Rank must also be defined. |
| 4. | FORWARD.RATES | This application allows the user to define the premium or discount expected for the exchange rate of the Euro against the local currency when it is Out- Currency. However, if involved currency is In-Currency type, premium or discount must not be applied for the Euro. |
| 5. | HOLIDAY | This application allows the user to define the public holidays for EU, for the calendar years over which the bank's current business is spread. |
| 6. | PEIRODIC.INTEREST | This application allows the user to default the interest rate for any time period, which can be used by applications like foreign exchange on forward contracts using interest revaluation method or loans and deposits applications to perform automatic rollover. For Euro module, periodic interest must be defined with forward euro interest rates. |
| 7. | BASIC.INTEREST | This application allows the user to define floating rates – Base Rate, Prime Rate and Overnight Rate. Whenever there is a change in the rate, user must define the interest rates for the currency with the date on which it becomes active. A record must be defined for Euro with the applicable rates along with effective date. |
| 8. | EU.PARAMETER | This application allows the user to define the following: Company code – Code of the company where local currency is converted. Routine to calculate the new Euro account number. Default category for internal suspense accounts when converting contracts from one currency to fixed currency. Internal account category code to be used for posting adjustment entries in the new local currency after the conversion of the base currency has taken place. Transaction code used for all adjustment entries posted by the conversion process. The rate used to convert local currency amounts from Original Lcy to Converted Lcy . |
| 9. | PM.CALENDAR | This application allows the user to define a calendar in which possible settlements is allowed for Euro. |

**Redenom of Contracts**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Id | The file has a free format key. |
| Application | Set to the appropriate application for the desired conversion: ACCOUNT LD.LOANS.AND.DEPOSITS MG.MORTGAGE MM.MONEY.MARKET SWAP |
| Select Field; Operand; Value | These fields specify the conditions of the contracts (or accounts), which are to be converted using the parameters of this record. The Select Field must be from the above application. |
| New Ccy | The currency for the new contract, that is, EUR. |
| Renumber Routine | Only used for account conversion. |
| Conversion Date | This field is optional for contracts. If entered, this date will be passed to the Conversion Date field in the created EU.CONTRACT.CONVERSION records. If not input, Conversion Date will be defaulted to the next interest schedule date, unless the Non Int Conv flag is set, in which case, the field will be defaulted to the current day. |
| Auto Clos Ac; Ac Post Restrict; Keep Mnemonic; Bal Transfer Type; Convert Sto | Only used for account conversion. |
| Ncu Limit Ref | The dummy LIMIT.REFERENCE record to be used on the maturing NCU contracts to avoid double exposure on the customer limit. Loans under commitment use different functionality in this regard, explained in the relevant section of this User Guide. |
| Ncu Susp Cat | The suspense category to be used for the early maturity of the NCU contract and the creation of the new EUR contract. This can be different from the setting in EU.PARAMETER , if required. |
| Ac Transfer Type; Ot Transfer Type | The internal and external FT.TXN.TYPE.CONDITION record to be used for any Funds Transfers that are created to account for principal schedules taking place on the conversion date. |
| Auth Records; Hold; Records; Ignored Records; Error Details | These system fields hold the results produced when this record is verified. They note the number of records that have been fully created, placed on hold due to override or error conditions, and have been ignored (if a EU.CONTRACT.CONVERSION record already exists for the contract), and any associated error messages. |
| Non Int Conv | If this flag is set to Yes, then contracts converted under this selection can be converted on a non-interest settlement date. Currently, this flag can only be set for LDs and MMs. |
| Int Transfer Type | The FT.TXN.TYPE.CONDITION record for the future dated FT created to post the suspended interest, if the Conversion Date is not an interest settlement date. |
| Int Susp Cat | The category of the suspense account to be used for the suspension of interest, if the Conversion Date is not an interest settlement date. |
| Local Ref | Standard system local reference field. |

**Redenom of Contracts**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Id | The transaction reference number of the contract to be converted. |
| Application | System Field holding the application of the contract to be converted. |
| Conversion Date | The value date at which the NCU contract is matured, and the new EUR contract starts. The Conversion Date defaults to the next interest settlement date, unless the Non Int Conv flag has been set to Yes, either from the EU.CCY.CONVERSION record or by using a version to pre-populate it, in which case the Conversion Date defaults to the current day. If the Non Int Conv flag on this record is set to Yes through direct user input, the Conversion Date is not automatically updated from its initial default value, but can be updated manually. |
| Old Ccy | No input field, recording the NCU currency. |
| New Ccy | Automatically populated with the fixed currency (that is, EUR). |
| Old Limit Ref | System Field recording the original LIMIT.REFERENCE record from the NCU contract. This will then be used on the new EUR contract. |
| New Limit Ref | The maturing NCU contract is updated to use this limit reference, so this should contain the dummy LIMIT.REFERENCE record. Loans under commitment use different functionality in this regard, which is explained in the relevant section of this user guide. |
| Bal Susp Cat | The suspense category to be used for the early maturity of the NCU contract and the creation of the new EUR contract. This defaults from the Ncu Susp Cat field. This record is created from EU.CCY.CONVERSION or from Cont Conv Susp Cat in EU.PARAMETER , but it can be updated to an alternative valid category, if required. |
| New Contract | After a conversion has been run, this system field is updated with the transaction id of the new EUR contract. |
| Actual Conv Date | This System Field records when the conversion was executed. The conversion takes place on an interest date, which can be before the Conversion Date (value date). |
| Original Amount | This System Field records the principal of the NCU contract prior to conversion. |
| Converted Amt | This System Field records the principal of the new EUR contract. If there has been a principal payment on the conversion date, then this will not be the EUR equivalent of the Original Amount . |
| Ac Transfer Type; Ot Transfer Type | The internal and external FT.TXN.TYPE.CONDITION record that is to be used for any funds transfers that are created to account for principal schedules taking place on the conversion date. |
| Repayment Ft; Repayment Amount | The ID and amount of any funds transfer raised to account for a principal schedule taking pace on conversion date. |
| Error Msg | This field holds any error message encountered during the creation of this record from EU.CCY.CONVERSION , or during the execution of the conversion. |
| Local Ref | Standard system local reference field. |
| Commit No |  |
| Drawdown Amt | This field holds the principal of the drawdown in the currency of the commitment when an LD drawdown under commitment is converted. |
| Non Int Conv | If this flag is set to yes, then Conversion Date can be set to any working day, not just the next interest settlement date. Currently, this flag can only be set for LDs and MMs. |
| Int Transfer Type | The FT.TXN.TYPE.CONDITION record for the future dated FT created to post the suspended interest, if the Conversion Date is not an interest settlement date. |
| Int Susp Cat | The Category of the suspense account to be used for the suspension of interest, if the Conversion Date is not an interest settlement date. |
| Interest Ft; Interest Amt; Int Value Date | These are system fields updated with the ID, amount and value date of the funds transfer created to post the suspended interest, if the Conversion Date is not an interest settlement date. |

### Framework - FT (FT)


**Misc**

| S.No. | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | FT.APPL.DEFAULT | This application allows the user to define application-level default values, which is used when processing FUNDS.TRANSFER or STANDING.ORDER instructions. These values will be applicable irrespective of the transaction type, and the user must create one record for each COMPANY (that is, in case of multi-company setup) on the system. |
| 2. | FT.TXN.TYPE.CONDITION | This application allows the user to define the default conditions for each transaction type, which can be processed by the FUNDS.TRANSFER and STANDING.ORDER applications. User can define Transaction Code Credit , Transaction Code Debit , Comm Types , Charge Types , Forw Value Max and Back Value Max for each transaction type. |
| 3. | FT.CHARGE.TYPE | This application allows the user to define the conditions related to various types of standard flat charges used by Temenos Transact . In addition, charge types can be linked to allow different charge structures, tax codes and so on to be applied depending on the residence of the ordering customer. |
| 4. | FT.COMMISSION.TYPE | This application allows the user to define the conditions related to all types of commission used in applications. Each commission type can be defined as a Flat Amount or variable amount, proportionate to the amount transferred. In the latter case, different percentages can be defined for different Bands or Levels of transfer amounts. Minimum and maximum commissions can be specified for each Band or Level together with overall minimum or maximum commission charges. |
| 5. | CORR.BANK.CHARGES | This application allows the user to define correspondent bank charges or commission, which will default in FT when Def Corr Bank Chgs field in FT.APPL.DEFAULT is set to Yes. |
| 6. | FT.GEN.CONDITION | This application allows the user to identify a specific group of customers, using a user-defined Funds Transfer General Condition number. , This will then be cross-related to the Group Condition table to define Funds Transfers conditions applicable to that group. The FT General Condition record must exist before any associated group condition is specified. The key to this table is also the key to the associated FT Group Condition record. |
| 7. | FT.GROUP.CONDITION | This application allows the user to define special conditions applicable to specific groups of customers or individual customers which overrides the normal conditions, used by the Funds Transfer application. A customer subjected to these conditions must first meet the selection criteria defined in FT.GEN.CONDITION and accessed using an identical key. |
| 8. | EB.DUPLICATE.TYPE | This application allows the user to define selected fields to check for any duplicate contracts for the given application. This application also allows the user to define duplicate check criteria for linked applications, which can be defined in the Linked Application field. It allows the user to select the following: Application for which the duplicate check criteria is defined. The fields from that application which will be part of the duplicate check. The number of purge days, which will ensure that the duplicate criteria check will be applied only for contracts raised in the past n days (number of days defined in the Purge Days field in this application). |

**Misc**

| S.No. | Product Name | Product Attributes |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | OC- Outward by Cheque | Refers to the issuance (by the bank) of a Manager Cheque or a Bank Cheque in local currency in favor of the beneficiary who does not maintain an account with the bank. |
| 2. | OD – Outward By Draft | Refers to the issuance (by the bank) of a Bank Draft (usually in foreign currency), in favor of the beneficiary who does not maintain an account with the bank. |
| 3. | OT –Outward by Telex | Refers to the issuance (by the bank) of a payment via Swift or Telex. The instructions are usually sent to the correspondent bank for processing. This transaction type will produce both pay and cover cables automatically where required. |
| 4. | OB – Outward by bankers payment | Refers to the issuance (by the bank) of a banker's payment in local currency. This method of payment is used extensively in the UK to perform local currency payment. |
| 5. | BC – Outward by BACS | This transaction type is only applicable for Sterling and within the UK and refers to outward transfers by BACS (Bankers Automatic Clearing System). Currently BACS payments are not generated by the system. If it is required, it must be added as a local enhancement. Other host countries may have similar systems to which this may be adapted. |
| 6. | IC – Inward payment by cheque or draft | Refers to the receipt of a cheque or a draft by the bank, to be credited to a customer account. |
| 7. | IT – Inward by Telex | Refers to the receipt of a Swift or Telex payment by bank in favor of bank's customers, where the proceeds have to be credited to an account in bank’s books. |
| 8. | IB – Inward by banker's payment | Refers to the receipt (by the bank) of a banker's payment in favor of an account in our books (UK only). |

| FTD - Financial application definitions | Financial parameter applications that does not contain data with amounts or rates linked to a particular local currency. For example, GEN.CONDITION type tables and BASIC.INTEREST . This type of application can be shared between lead companies. |
| FTF - Financial application data | Financial parameter applications that contain financial data, often contain local currency amounts. The following are the example of FTF application: GROUP.DEBIT.INT GENERAL.CHARGE TAX This type of TAX application can be shared between lead companies. |
| CCY - Currency applications | Contains currency related information, for example, CURRENCY and PERIODIC.INTEREST . This type of application can be shared between lead companies. |

### Framework - PM (PM)


**Misc**

| Contract or Movement | Description |
|---|---|
| Fixed Maturity (Loans and Deposits) | This includes the cash flow at start and future event dates. Start dates show only the principal, whereas the maturity or event date cash flow reflects both principal and interest total (fee or charge) amounts. Deals past their start date only shows the cash flow for future dates, the start date cash flow being incorporated naturally into Account or Nostro balances. Contracts are not included once it reaches the maturity date. |
| Call or Notice | This is included from start date for Fixed Maturity contracts: Maturity date reflects the earliest repayment date, based on the number of days from today, until a finite maturity date is entered. Contracts are not included once it reaches the maturity date. |
| AC Balances | This is shown according to the 'Call' for including any accrued interest from date of last capitalisation. |
| Nostro Balances | This is shown according to 'Call' for including any accrued interest from date of last capitalisation. |
| FT | Any cash movements generated during the online day are immediately taken into the cash flow ladder. |
| DC | Any cash movements generated during the online day are immediately taken into the cash flow ladder. |
| TT | Any cash movements generated during the online day are immediately taken into the cash flow ladder. |
| FX | This shows principal cash flows until value date, when they are incorporated naturally into the Account and Nostro balances. The buy side of the contract is taken as an inflow and sell as an outflow. |
| FRA | Prior to settlement date, the projected cash flow is shown at settlement date. After settlement date, the true amount is shown only for settlement date. It is not shown after settlement date but incorporated naturally into the Account or Nostro balances. |

**Misc**

| S.No. | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | PM.AC.PARAM | Parameters governing the rules for handling the cash accounts and the online update of accounts in the PM module are defined in this table. |
| 2. | PM.APPLICATION.PARAM | This parameter table is used to define the conditions for forming PM groups for Temenos Transact applications, which is linked to PM processing through the generic interface. |
| 3. | PM.CALENDAR | The position reference, for a transaction, is linked to a calendar record, whose purpose is to provide time splits by which information is grouped. The near time period is in days and the far time period can be in months, quarters and years. In addition to the default record in PM.CAS and PM.GAP , banks can add their own calendar record based on the required time buckets and the same can be chosen while launching PM.CAS and PM.GAP enquiries in the selection criteria. |
| 4. | PM.ENQUIRY.PARAM | A parameter record in PM enquiry Param file defines PM enquiries. Each enquiry references a record on this parameter table by the enquiry name itself. Once the format and layout of an enquiry are fixed, it can be copied and these records are used to give selective and different views of the data. |
| 5. | PM.GROUP.TYPE | The mapping of values from an application attached to PM to the fields in PM.TRAN.ACTIVITY table, through generic interface, can be defined using this table. |
| 6. | PM.LD.PARAM | The parameters governing the position management of Loans and Deposits can be defined in this table. These are pre-defined setup, that cannot be amended. |
| 7. | PM.PARAMETER | This parameter table is used to define the applications to be included for Position Management processing and whether or not Deal or Contract files, that are already in existence to be included in the overnight rebuild of PM data. |
| 8. | PM.PC.PARAM | This parameter table is used to define parameters for generation of account and forex-related position movements in PM.TRAN.ACTIVITY for modules or applications linked to PM Module through generic interface. The PM PC param records are configured in model, and it is recommended that the users do not change the setup. |
| 9. | PM.POSITION.CLASS | This setup is used to record all the activities used to build different types of positions such as GAP, Cashflow, Forex, and others. The transactions from various applications are divided into multiple activities and the position class IDs are assigned to each of the activities. The position class ID serves as a link between each activity and various positions defined in the PM.POSN.REFERENCE table. |
| 10. | PM.POSITION.REFERENCE | Grouping of activities from PM Position Class into positions is done using this table. Positions defined by the user refer to the following: GAP Position – To monitor the interest rate exposure Cash Position – To monitor the cash-flow and liquidity exposure FX Position – To monitor the currency exposure Positions can further be consolidated by period, dealer desk or group and currency market or group. |
| 11. | PM.SC.PARAM | Parameters governing the rules for handling the financial assets in the Position Management module are defined in this table. Records need to be defined for overall positions such as CAS, GAP, and others. |
| 12. | PM.SWAP.PARAM | Parameters governing the rules for handling the processing of Swap Contracts in Position Management module are defined in this table. |


### Framework - RC (RC)


**Hybrid Pooling**

| Account Type | Company Name | System Date |
|---|---|---|
| CT account (100001) | Temenos core banking Norway company | 25/10/2017 |
| TR account (100002) | Temenos core banking Norway Sweden | 23/10/2017 |
| TR account (100003) | Temenos Core Banking Norway Finland | 24/10/2017 |

**Misc**

| S.NO | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Account | The Account property class is used by all the products which are account based. This property class primarily controls the description of the account. The ACCOUNT property allows the user to define and control balance treatment, posting restriction, linked account number (for memo accounts), currency market, date convention related setup for the account. Although the account names are account specific, generic titles can be defaulted from the product and can be replaced or given additional detail at the arrangement level. Each product defined and processed in AA can have a single ACCOUNT Property defined. |
| 2 | Activity Charges | The Activity Charges property class defines the charges that have to be applied when a particular activity is triggered on the arrangement. The charges so applied can be made due, capitalised or deferred. The user can enable auto settle the charges made due from unallocated credit balance by setting this to Yes. In accounts, charges are enabled for dormancy, settle payoff and ageing. This property class is also extensively used for all AA related modules, charges are set for various other activities. |
| 3 | Activity Restriction | The Activity Restriction property class is used to specify a restriction on a particular transaction. The restriction rules including the relevant periodic attributes and activities are defined in the product condition. These rules are then used to define activity based or property based restrictions. A rule if broken can be set to result in an override or error. A charge can be attached for this and can be set to be made due, capitalised or deferred. For the AR module, activity restriction is extensively used for restricting transactions by number, type, and so on. This is also extensively used in other modules to restrict the user from doing various user activity based on the life cycle status of contracts. |
| 4 | Balance Availability | The Balance Availability property class allows the user to control the following features pertaining to AR module: Notice amount and period, which needs to be given by a customer for withdrawing money from his account. Default Credit Check and Available Balance update related set up. Activity class or Activity specific credit check, and NSF related fees pertaining to it Tolerance Amount or Tolerance Currency - To indicate the grace amount, which is the allowed overdraft before the bank imposes NSF or OD fees. Overdraft Grace Period - To waive the NSF fee levied on the account, if the customer clears the debit balance within the stipulated grace period. |
| 5 | Dormancy | The Dormancy property class allows the user to control the parameterisation of inactive or dormant accounts and movement of the same into various buckets at the arrangement or product level. The same can be controlled based on period, and some exceptions or rules also can be added for evaluation and movement. The user can include or exclude certain activity or activity class for the evaluation. It is possible to, Configure different Dormancy status based on the period of inactivity Specify different charges and charging frequency for each Dormancy status Apply some exception rule filtering at an individual arrangement level (for example, account is in debit balance) and such rules can either be an API or a rule created using the Rules Engine Specify notices and notice frequency for each Dormancy status Specify Activities or Activity Classes or Activity Initiation Types which are qualified to keep an account active. Auto Reset can be enabled based on status or on Activity Type. |
| 6 | Facility | The Facility is a service component for financial products designed using arrangement architecture. The Facility property class controls the list of available services for an arrangement account. When an external activity (financial or non-financial) is triggered and the corresponding service group is mapped to an activity through Activity Mapping and EB.EVENTS . And the same came allowed or restricted or charged corresponding error message is raised to stop the activity. |
| 7 | Inheritance | The Inheritance property class is used for BN pool structure for inheriting the product conditions set at Parent level arrangement to the Child level arrangement accounts. The product conditions that are set for inheritance are attached to Property records with type as Inheritance Only. The properties to be inherited can be controlled both at source and target level. |
| 8 | Interest | The Interest property class is used for all interest definition and processing in AA. A product defined and processed in AA can have multiple interest properties defined (for example, principal interest, penalty interest, commission, etc. Interest rates can be defined as fixed , floating , periodic or linked rate (referring an INTEREST property from other arrangement), routine based calculation. Tiered interest can also be defined. Further it is possible to define a negative rate, minimum interest amount and waive the interest. Interest adjustment can be done in run time, and adjustment related detail or values can be captured in adjustment related fields. |
| 9 | Limit | The Limit property class primarily controls the use of LIMIT module by the product. We can set up single or shared limit. We can define the LIMIT.REFERENCE applicable for a specific product such that the system defaults the same in an arrangement. For a new limit, at the arrangement level, the LIMIT.SERIAL has to be given as NEW. The AR module can have self-contained secondary limit without having actual limit attached to it. Overdraft status or notice for AR module is handled inside the Limit Property class. Further Limits can be set to use the LIMIT module (AL and AD) or it can be managed only within the arrangement architecture framework. |
| 10 | Payment Schedule | The Payment Schedule property class is used by all products which have amounts billed (that is,made due) or capitalised or Pay. A Payment Schedule can be comprised of one or more payment definitions with conditions such as payment Type and Method, arrangement properties, dates and amounts. The AA.PAYMENT.TYPE application is used to define the standard payment types such as constant, linear, actual and fixed equal and so on, that can be used by a product. This payment type is then attached to each payment schedule definition. The start and end date can be specified, the user can specify the repayment of arrangement to commence after ‘n’ months from the arrangement date or ‘n’ months before the maturity or ‘n’ months after the change product or reset and rollover has happened. |
| 11 | Periodic Charges | The Periodic Charges property class acts as a container to group different charge properties and calculate a periodic charge amount. The Payment Schedule property class drives this property class. A periodic charge property can be attached in payment schedule and on schedule date periodic charge amount is calculated. At the arrangement level adjustment can be done by the user on whole periodic charge. |
| 12 | Statement | The Statement property class is used to define the legacy ACCT.STATEMENT feature at the AA level. Statements may be produced daily (every working day), every 1-9 weeks, twice a month (on the 15th and the last day of the month) or every 1-12 months on any day of the month. Up to nine statement cycles may be specified for each account, and each statement cycle is independent. In addition to this, special interim statements can be enabled. This property class also controls whether or not advices are to be produced when interest and charges are applied, and whether detailed interest statements (interest scale) should be produced. Within a statement cycle, it is possible to define multiple frequencies with a combination of weekly and monthly, such that statements are produced on the dates specified by both frequencies, but only contain details of entries since the last statement in that cycle. |

### Framework - RD (RD)


**Centralised Bank Directory**

| S.No. | Field Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | Upld Param Id | This field must be set to SYSTEM. |
| 2. | Description | This field represents a standard Temenos Transact alphanumeric field and allows the bank to assign a description. |
| 3. | Action | This field uploads the file from SWIFT. It holds the following values: If set to OVERWRITE, the existing records in the table are cleared. If set to UPDATE, the existing records are not cleared and the information is just updated. |
| 4. | Upload Type | This field indicates if the uploaded file is the one indicated by the user or the process can pick the file(s) automatically based on the upload rules. This field holds the following values: Automated – The system checks the available files and starts uploading them according to the upload rules. Either the File Name Format or File Name Format Api is mandatory when this option is chosen. Manual – The system only uploads the file indicated by the user. The File Nam e is mandatory for this option. |
| 5. | File Type | This field indicates the type of file to be uploaded and is applicable for automated uploads. This field holds the following values: Daily Delta Monthly Full Monthly Delta |
| 6. | File Location | Indicates the path where the file is held. |
| 7. | File Name | Indicates the name of the file to load. |
| 8. | Delimiter | This field distinguishes the data contents within the file. |
| 9. | Action On Miss File | This field indicates the actions taken by the process when a file is missing. It holds the following values: Stop – If the next file is not found then the upload process stops. Skip – If the next file is not found then the upload process continues with the next available file. |
| 10. | File Name Format | This field indicates the naming convention of the file(s), which must be uploaded. This field is in line with the option in the File Type and match with the pattern provided by SWIFT to identify the publication date. |
| 11. | File Name Format Api | This field indicates the Local API to determine which file(s) must be picked. |
| 12. | Last Publication Date | This field indicates the date of the last publication file which was uploaded. Only the files after this date are considered for automatic upload. |
| 13. | Archive File Location | This field indicates the path where the processed files are moved. The absence of this path deletes the processed file from database. |
| 14. | Local Mapping Api | This field allows the CMB or local layers to indicate an upload or mapping logic to map details from the uploaded file in the directory. |

**Centralised Bank Directory**

| Field Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| id | Indicates a unique identifier of a national clearing system formed by a country code followed by ‘.’ and a sequence number Some countries use more than one national identifier (for example, in the US, both ABA and Fedwire are used. |
| Country | Indicates the country code of a national clearing system |
| Iso Clearing Sys Id | Indicates the ISO identifier of the national clearing system. It should be populated with the value prefixed by “ISO5:” and before the next “,” (comma) in the FIELD B of the NATIONALIDFORMAT file. If the FIELD B is populated with ISO5:GBDSC, ISO2:SC, then use GBDSC |
| Swift Clr Sys Id | Indicates the clearing prefix used in the SWIFT MT message. It should be populated with the value prefixed by ISO2 in FIELD B of the NATIONALIDFORMAT file. If the FIELD B is populated with ISO5:GBDSC, ISO2:SC, then use SC |
| Clr Sys Acrynm | Indicates the NATIONAL ID LOCAL ACRONYM in the NATIONALIDFORMAT file |
| National Id Format | Indicates the format of the National Id. It should be populated with the value of the REGEX FORMAT field in the NATIONALIDFORMAT file |
| National Id Type | Indicates the National Id Type specified. It should be populated with the value of the NATIONAL ID TYPE IN BDP field of the NATIONALIDFORMAT file |

**Misc**

| File Type | Frequency | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Daily full | Once a month | The daily full file is only required for an optional data resynchronisation. The daily full file is published as a separate file along with the daily delta. |
| Daily delta | Every day, including weekends | This file contains only the changes of the previous day. |
| Monthly full | Once a Month | The file contains full details. |
| Monthly delta | Once a month | The file contains the changes from the previous month. |

| Parameters | Description |
|---|---|
| RD.PARAMETER | This parameterization application allows the bank to set the RD module as the main reference data for BICs and National IDs and decide if the BIC must be validated or not |
| RD.BANK.DIR.UPLD.PARAM | This application allows the bank to define the main parameters related to the upload of the SWIFTRef Bank Directory Plus file |
| RD.CENTRAL.BANK.DIR | This application stores the bank directory and stores the BIC, National ID, and LEIs. The directory is populated automatically based on the SWIFTRef Bank Directory Plus published by SWIFT |
| RD.CTRY.NAT.SYS.IDENTIFIER | This application allows the bank to define the country’s national system identifiers (the ISO Clearing Codes, the national id types used in the respective countries, and the ISO2 code used in the SWIFT MT message to identify the national clearing systems) |
| RD.GPI.UPLD.PARAM | This application defines the upload parameter for the GPI Directory |
| RD.SWIFT.GPI.DIR | This application stores the GPI Directory populated based on the SWIFT gpi Directory. |

**SWIFT Gpi Directory**

| S.No. | Field Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | Flag | Indicates if there is a change in the record, since the last release of the SWIFT gpi Directory structure file. This field holds the following values: A – Addition since last SWIFT gpi Directory file. D – Deletion since last SWIFT gpi Directory file. M – Modification since last SWIFT gpi Directory file. |
| 2. | Source Key | Indicates the identifier of the record in the SWIFT gpi Directory file. |
| 3. | Cbd Recordkey | Indicates the corresponding record key of the participant in the Temenos Transact Centralised Bank Directory, containing the participant's details. |
| 4. | Platform | Indicates the service platform. |
| 5. | Service | Indicates the Service type identifier. For example, the value of field is 111 in block 3 of the gpi MT103. |
| 6. | Service Name | Indicates the name of the service. |
| 7. | Participant Id | Indicates the participant's routing ID, at which it is reachable for receiving gpi payments. For example, it can be a BIC8 followed by XXX, a BIC8 followed by a three-character branch code, or a clearing code ( National Id ) of the non-FIN PMI (payment market infrastructure not on FIN). |
| 8. | Id Type | Indicates the type of the identifier used for the Participant Id , such as the BIC or a National Id of a non-FIN PMI (Payment Market Infrastructure not on FIN). |
| 9. | Participant Name | Indicates the institution name of the participant. |
| 10. | Country | Indicates the two character ISO country code of the participant. |
| 11. | Ccy Code | Indicates the three character ISO currency code. |
| 12. | Cut off time | Indicates the participant's public gpi cut-off time for gpi payments in this currency. |
| 13. | Cut Off Day | Cut-off day can be empty (same day cut-off time) or can contain the value ‘D-n’ (where n can be a value between 1 and 9). |
| 14. | Local Time Zone | Indicates the time zone of the participant. |
| 15. | Act As Intermediary | Y (Yes) or N (No) flag specifying whether the participant acts as the gpi Intermediary Agent for gpi payments in a given currency and over a given reachable through channel (in Reachable Through field ). |
| 16. | Reachable Through | Indicates the channel through which the participant is reachable for gpi payment instructions for one of its gpi currencies. |
| 17. | Channel Type | Indicates the type of the Reachable Through channel. This field holds the following values: Intermediary FIN-PMI (payment market infrastructure on FIN) D-C (direct or cover) NON-FIN-PMI (payment market infrastructure not on FIN) |
| 18. | Start Date | Indicates the future date when the record becomes valid (including this day itself, if it is a business day). |
| 19. | Stop Date | Indicates the future date until the record is valid (including this day itself, if it is a business day). |
| 20. | Ssi Record Key | Indicates the record key of the Standing Settlement Instruction (SSI) in SWIFTRef's SSI plus directory for this participant and currency. |
| 21. | Delegated To | Indicates the BIC which forwards the payment or updates the tracker on behalf of the participant ID. It is a valid BIC of eight characters. |
| 22. | Source Name | This field is populated because of the upload process with the File Name of the SWIFT gpi Directory, through which the record is created, amended or deleted in the system. |
| 23. | Entry Type | This field is set by the system and indicates if the record is created or maintained through an upload or manually. It holds the following values: Upload – The record is created through upload. Custom – The record is created manually. |
| 24. | Status | This field indicates the status of the record. |
| 25. | Allowed Company | This field indicates that the record is available only for those companies that are mentioned. |
| 26. | Excluded Company | This field indicates that the record is available for all the companies, but not for the one excluded. |

**Misc**

|---|---|
| DE.EOP.INWARD and DE.EOP.OUTWARD | These services analyse the DE.O.HEADER and DE.I.HEADER entries respectively to identify the records that are processed completely. These services select the DE.I.HEADER and DE.O.HEADER records, moving the records from DE.I.HEADER to DE.I.HEADER.ARCH and DE.O.HEADER to DE.O.HEADER.ARCH respectively. |
| DE.MM.CLEAR.HANDOFF | This service deletes the DE.O.HANDOFF records where DE.O.HEADER is previously removed. This service selects all the DE.O.HANDOFF records to identify the records to be deleted. |

**Misc**

| S.No | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | Tracker Status Reason | Allows users to define the status code and status reason which is used to update the status of the incoming MT103 payment in the SWIFT Confirmation tracker. |
| 2. | DE.MESSAGE.HEADER | Allows users to define the message headers, which are used for various type of messages. For each header, it stores the version, set of Business and Generic Metadata, which must be pushed as part of the data event with the payload. |
| 3. | DE.BUSINESS.SERVICE.RULES | Allows users to create business service rules for delivery messages based on domain, message name id, business application, application context field, application context value, start date, end date, business service and status. When a Delivery Message is handed off to Delivery, it considers the supplied value if the Business Application supplies the Business Service. Otherwise, it determines the Business Service based on the DE.BUSINESS.SERVICE.RULES application setup. |
| 4. | DE.DELIVERY.RESPONSES | Stores the incoming replies received for the outward interact MX messages (Ack/Nack/DLN) sent through delivery. It is possible to store other replies sent by other bank systems, which are acting as an intermediary systems before the messages sent to SWIFT network. |
| 5. | DE.DLN.REQUIREMENTS | Allows the bank to define the rules to request a positive or overdue delivery notification. In this way, the bank has the option to request a positive delivery notification and overdue warning (Optional). It is not possible to request only overdue warning. |
| 6. | DE.ALT.CHARS | This table helps to parameterise the alternate characters (defined in ASCII.VAL.TABLE ) for the local unsupported characters. Various rules are defined to replace the alt chars based on the position of the unsupported character in the message string. A default alternate character is defined if alternate character is not defined for an unsupported character. |
| 7. | DE.MSG.CHARS.RULE | This parameter table defines the character set rules for each carrier and message type. |

**Archiving**

| Field(s) | Description |
|---|---|
| Descriptn.1 , Descriptn.2 , Descriptn.3 and Descriptn.4 | Indicates the four distinct sections in this record |
| Purge Date and Retention Period | System selects the record to be archived, based on the dates specified in either the Purge Date or Retention Period field. The selected records are archived (or deleted). Purge date is automatically calculated from retention period, during runtime. If today's date is 23 May, 2012 and the retention period of three months is specified (03M), the three month period is calculated from the beginning of the current month. Therefore, records dated before 1 February, 2012 (purge date) are archived (or deleted). |
| Archive Data | Indicates whether the selected records need to be archived or deleted, with respect to the value in this field. Y – Archive N or None – Delete |
| Arc Pathname | Specifies the destination location of the $ARC archive files. If this field is blank, the $ARC files are created in the archive directory (BNK.arc). |
| Arc Filename | Indicates the names of all the $ARC files that are created based on the specified type and modulo. If the type and modulo specification are not present, the ARC files inherit these details from the corresponding live files. It is a multi-value field. |
| Company Run In, Time Started, User Id, Date Selected, Stop Requested, Recs Deleted, Recs Processed, Error Msg, Time Ended | Maintain a history of the archives. The system populates these multi-value fields after the contracts are archived. |
| Generic Method | Indicates whether the generic archival process may be executed or not, with respect to your input. Y – Executes generic archival process. This allows archival service (ARC.GENERIC service) to look after all selection and purging of records. FUNDS.TRANSFER , TELLER , STMT.ENTRY.DETAIL and so on are archived through the generic archival process, with respect to the values input in Main File , Field To Check or Filter Routine fields. No or None – Application specific archival routine specified in the Routine field is invoked. |
| Main File | Accepts the file name (for example, FUNDS.TRANSFER$HIS) input that has to be archived. If this field is multi-valued and populated with two or more applications, the date mentioned in Field To Check is applicable to the application specified in the first multi-value field. |
| Field To Check | Indicates the date field in the contract, which is compared with the Purge date for archiving. If this field is blank, the standard Date Time field is used for comparison. In order to archive the history records of the FUNDS.TRANSFER record, use the Processing Date of the contract. |
| Filter Rtn | It is a hook routine to select or ignore a contract for archiving. This field is an alternate to Field To Check field. The IN and OUT parameters of this routine are: IN Parameters Id Contract – Indicates the record key of the contract R Contract – Indicates the entire contract record OUT Parameters Contractarchive Date – Indicates the date against which the purge date set in the ARCHIVE record is compared. In FUNDS.TRANSFER, you may compare debit value and credit value date of the contract and return a final date as the OUT parameter, which is compared with purge date for archival. Skip Flag – Returns ‘1’ as the OUT parameter, which confirms that the current contract need not be archived. Logic to ignore the contract is available in the filter routine and the current contract is skipped from being archived. Two spare parameters for future expansion. |
| Related Files Rtn | It is a hook routine that returns the names of related files that have to be archived along with the main archival record in a dynamic array.The IN and OUT parameters of this routine are: IN Parameters Id Contract – Indicates the record key of the main contract that is ready to be archived R Contract – Indicates the entire contract record OUT Parameters Related Files – Indicates the information of related files to be archived in 'file name, file ID, archival flag separated by @VM' format. If there are multiple related files, each file information is delimited by @FM marker. Upon archiving LOANS.AND.DEPOSITS records, file records to be archived are balanced. So, pass the balances file name, its ID and a ‘Y’ to the Archival flag. Two spare parameters for future expansion. |
| Routine | Indicates a valid multi-threaded routine that is responsible for archiving the set of files specified in the ARCHIVE record. These are application specific routines that should not be changed unless a site specific program is written. For FOREX , the routine is ARC.FOREX. This record routine is responsible to decide the archival logic and perform the archival. Separate ARC.FOREX.LOAD and ARC.FOREX.SELECT routines must be available for opening and selecting all necessary files for archiving. However, it is not necessary to create a separate ARC.FOREX service. It is the responsibility of ARC.GENERIC service to simply invoke ARC.FOREX.LOAD, ARC.FOREX.SELECT, ARC.FOREX routines internally for archiving in the presence of Routine field. |

**Access IBAN and Centralised Reference Data**

| IBAN-Related Public Methods | Description |
|---|---|
| IBANService.CheckIBANRequired | This method raises an error if the IBAN structure is not found for the country code. The following are the possible options: Returns O (optional) when Mand Commence Date and Opt Commence Date are blank and when Opt Commence Date is before or same as the request date Returns M (Mandatory) when Mand Commence Date is before or equal to the supplied request date Returns N (not allowed) in all other cases |
| IBANService.getIBANDetails | This method returns all the component details of an IBAN. It extracts the country code of the IBAN and then checks the IBAN structure for that country. An error is raised if the IBAN structure for the country is not found or if the IBAN cannot be used yet in that country ( Mandatory Commence Date or Opt Commence Date is in the future) If the IBAN structure for that country is found and can be used, it returns its details based on country structure definition |
| IBANService.getIBAN | This API returns the IBAN stored as the alternate account number in the supplied account, which is identified by the alternate account type T24.IBAN. It returns an error if the alternate account number is not stored in the corresponding ACCOUNT record. |
| IBANService.getIBANBankCode | This method returns the bank code from IBAN. The given IBAN is validated to return the bank code part . |
| IBANService.getAccountBusinessId | This method returns the bank identifier part of the T24.IBAN stored in the ACCOUNT record. |
| IBANService.getIBANStructure | This method returns: The IBAN structure for the provided country. It returns an Error when the definition of the country is not found. The IBAN structure of the local country for the supplied company, if country code is not supplied. The IBAN structure of the local country for the company in which the request is processed, if neither the company code nor the country code are supplied. |
| IBANService.calculateIBANCheckDigit | This method returns the calculated check digit for IBAN or BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number). |
| IBANService.getIbanNumberGenerated | This method generates IBAN based on the supplied Account Number , Country Code , Bank Id , and Branch Id . |
| IBANService.getBankOwnBankIdentifier | This method returns the bank identifier for a company or country. |
| IBANService.GenerateIBAN | This method generates an IBAN for a new account. |
| IBANService.getIBANLength | This method returns the total length of IBAN for a company. |
| IBANService.getIBANBranchCode | This method returns the branch code from an IBAN. The given IBAN is validated first, and then the branch code part is returned. |
| IBANService.getBICfromNtlIDCtryCode | This method returns Bank Identifier Code (BIC) when National ID and country code are passed. |
| IBANService.getBICfromNtlIDCtryCode | This method returns the calculated check digit for IBAN or BBAN with a dummy check digit. |
| IBANService.ValidateIBAN | This method extracts the country code of the IBAN and then checks the IBAN structure for that country. If a local validation API is attached to the country code in the IBAN structure, it uses that local API to validate the structure of the IBAN. If the local validation API is not present, then it validates the following: If the IBAN length matches the length of the IBAN defined in the country’s IBAN structure The check digits If the National ID included in the IBAN is not present in the Temenos IBAN Exclusion list directory (considers the custom record if any, else it checks the master or future dated record, and the set up for allowed or excluded company apply to the request). The API returns an error to indicate that the IBAN is not valid when any validation fails and if the IBAN structure is not found for that country. |
| getBankOwnBranchIdentifier | This method returns the branch identifier for a company or country. |
| ST.CHECK.PRODUCT.ENABLED | This method enables the business applications to decide on enabling or disabling IBAN . The method checks for the presence of the IN license if no record is defined in the MS.PARAMETER (Transact monolith implementation). In a distributed architecture, the method refers the set up in the MS.PARAMETER application. The Use IBAN Reference Data field is set to Yes indicates that the IBAN Reference Data is enabled. |

**Access IBAN and Centralised Reference Data**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| RD.GET.COUNTRY.NATIONAL.SYS.IDS | This method is used to retrieve the country’s national system identifiers based on the supplied country code, swift prefix, or iso clearing id. It returns the country national system identifiers ( Country, Iso Clearing Sys Id, and Swift Clr Sys Id ) based on the supplied National Id after checking the country national system identifiers application.The method looks for the Iso Clearing Sys Id and Swift Clr Sys Id in the RD.CTRY.NAT.SYS.IDENTIFIER application if the Country is provided. The supplied National Id is validated against the regular expression identified in the National Id Format field(s) if more than one record is found. An error is raised if the match is not found and if matches, then the first match is returned. If Iso Clearing Sys Id is provided, then the API looks up in country national system identifiers to find Country and Swift Clr Sys Id . If more than one record is found, then it uses the National Id Format to verify if it matches the supplied National Id : If none matches, then an error is raised. If both matches, then the first match is returned. If Swift Clr Sys Id is provided, the API looks up in the country’s national system identifiers to find the Iso Clearing Sys Id and Swift Clr Sys Id . If more than one record is found, it uses the National Id Format , which matches the supplied National Id . If none matches, then an error is raised. If both match, then the first one is returned. |
| RD.GET.BIC.FROM.NATIONAL.ID | This method is used to retrieve the details of a BIC based on the supplied National Id and its Country Code , Iso Clearing Id , or Swift Prefix . If Country Code , Iso Clearing Id , or Swift Prefix is not supplied, then the local country code is used to identify the BIC. Using the supplied Country and National Id , it finds the BIC in the centralised bank directory as follows: Retrieves the customised record for supplied Country and National Id (if exists) The current or future-dated master records are considered if the customised record is not found. The HO record takes precedence If HO is not present, then any record which has BIC is considered If BIC is not present in any record, then the Parent Office key in the first available record is considered Check for that RecordKey in the customized record, and if not present, check the current or future dated record which is before or afterthe request date It returns the Institution , Post box number, and City if the record is found. |
| RD.VALIDATE.BIC | The method is used to validate the structure of a supplied BIC value and its presence in the central bank directory. Only the structure of BIC is checked if the BIC validation is not enabled. Returns BIC is valid if all the checks are passed. |
| RD.GET.NATIONAL.ID.FROM.BIC | This method is used to retrieve the National Id and the details related to the National Id based on the supplied BIC. The following steps are performed by this method to check the centralised bank directory: Checks if a custom record for that BIC exists, and if yes, it considers its details. If the custom record does not exist, but a future-dated record exists, and its date is before the current /request business date, then the future-dated record is considered. If the future-dated record does not exist or the future date is after the current/request business date, the current BIC record is considered. Returns an error if the current record is not found. |
| RD.GET.PARTICIPANT.DETAILS | This method is used to return GPI (Global Payments Innovation) record details based on BIC and National ID provided. |
| RD.GET.PARAM.REC | This method enables the business applications to decide on enabling or disabling bank RD. In a distributed architecture, the method refers to the set up of the Use Bank Reference Data field in the MS.PARAMETER application. If this is set to Yes, the method uses the MDAL to check if the bank RD is enabled or not. |
| RD.VAL.BIC.NAT.ID | This method is used to validate if the supplied BIC and National Id matches. |
| RD.GET.BIC.FROM.LEI | This method is used to retrieve BIC from the Legal Entity Identifier code. |
| RD.GET.NATIONAL.ID.VALIDITY | This method is used to check the validity of the National Id based on the Country Code or the scheme provided when the usage of National Id is excluded in IBAN. |
| RD.GENERATE.CREDITOR.REF.API | This method is used to calculate and return structured creditor reference based on the ISO 11649 standard for the supplied creditor reference. |
| RD.VALIDATE.CREDITOR.REF.API | This method is used to validate if the structured creditor reference is formed as per ISO 11649 standard. |
| DE.VALIDATE.SWIFT.ADDRESS | This method enables the business applications to identify if the RD or the legacy BIC directory is enabled as reference data and validate the BIC accordingly: If RD is installed and enabled as main central reference data(*), it validates the BIC using this directory If RD is installed but not enabled as main reference data (set up in the RD.PARAMETER ), it validates both or any of the BIC and its structure depending on the parameterization in DE.BIC.PARAMETER If RD is not installed, it validates both or any of the BIC and its structure depending on the parameterization in DE.BIC.PARAMETER |
| ST.GET.BIC.DETAILS | This method validates if the BIC exists and returns all the BIC record details from the directory. To validate, It checks for the custom record for that BIC: If the custom record does not exist, it checks the current and future-dated records to find which one applies based on the date current or supplied business date. It returns the details of the found record. It returns an error if the BIC does not exist. |

|---|---|
| @ID | Indicates the identification of the address rule. |
| Description | Specifies the description of the address rule. This field is mandatory. |
| Address Attribute | Indicates the Temenos Transact address related field in the CUSTOMER application, which stores an address attribute that is part of the address rule. Multiple address attributes are captured, when each of them have a number of associated characteristics. |
| Label | Indicates the label that is displayed for a particular field. If any specific label is not provided, then the system displays the standard field name. |
| Min Length | Indicates the minimum number of characters to be entered for the respective address attribute. By defining the minimum (that is, one character), it implies that it is considered a mandatory address attribute. If a minimum length for an attribute is not defined, the system considers the respective address attribute as optional for an entry. |
| Max Length | Indicates the maximum number of characters to be entered for the respective address attribute. This value cannot be higher than the maximum length of the field definition. |
| Char Type | Specifies the type of characters that are entered. The IN2 routine is used to validate the input. The accepted character types are N, A, ANY, D (date) and AMT (amount). |
| Pattern Match | Specifies the pattern used when validating the input in the Address Attribute field. |
| Lookup List | Specifies the list of values (lookup) against which the content of the Address Attribute field is validated. |
| Lookup Application | Specifies the alternate to a list mentioned in the Lookup List field, a different option is provided, respectively to choose an address attribute from a list of values stored in an application vetting table located in Temenos Transact . |
| Validation Api | Allows the country and local layer to attach a routine and to implement more complex validation rules. |

| Remarks | Defines the remarks relevant to the customer closure, if any. |
| Request Status | Defines the progress status of the closure request. |
| Closure Date | This field represents the date when the closure request has been approved successfully after the pre-closure checks. The system updates this field when Request Status is Approved. |
| Reopened Date | Defines the date on which the customer closure request has been re-opened. |

**Customer Closure**

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| Approved | Request Status is Approved when the pre-closure check is successful. If the request is approved, Closure Date is updated in the customer closure request. |
| Failed | Request Status is Failed when the closure request has failed the pre-closure checks. |
| Cancelled | Request Status is Cancelled when the closure request is cancelled. The user can manually cancel a request in Pending or Failed status. The cancelled request is moved to history during the subsequent pre-closure check process. |
| Reopened | Request Status is Reopened when an approved closure request is re-opened. This is allowed only for Exit Status when Allow Remove Exit Status is set as Yes in ST.CUSTOMER.EXIT.STATUS . |

**Customer Risk Group**

| S. No. | Field | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | System Use | The Risk customer groups are used for risk purposes. Hence, it is linked to limits. The customer groups with a purpose code of risk type only can be attached to the limit structure. Only one purpose type of risk defined at any given time. |
| 2. | Unique Customer | If this field is set to Yes, the system does not allow any customers who belong to a customer group with this purpose (OPERATIONAL) to be part of another customer group. |
| 3. | Update Group Relation | If this field is set to Yes, the system automatically converts the real life relation and creates a new technical relationship between two customers in the CUSTOMER.GROUP record based on the group relationship mapping. If this field is set to No, then the system does not automatically upload the Relationship field in the CUSTOMER.GROUP record. |
| 4. | Update Relation | If this field is set to No, then the system does automatically upload the Relationship field in the CUSTOMER.GROUP record. If this field is set to Yes, the system automatically uploads the Relationship field in the CUSTOMER.GROUP record based on pre-defined party relationships. |
| 5. | Cust Sub Group | This field indicates if a customer can belong only to one or multiple sub-groups at any given moment in time. Unique: The system validates and allows a customer to be part of only one sub-group. Multiple: The system allows a customer to be part of multiple sub-groups. None: The system does not allow any customer to be part of a sub-group and any sub-group to be defined. |
| 6. | Group Type | The values for the group type are defined using the EB.LOOKUP application. Group types can take the values like HouseHold or Corporate. The DEFAULT group type is released by Temenos and is used to define a generic setup for the group purpose when specific Group Type validations are not required. If the user enters a Group Type in the CUSTOMER.GROUP record that is not defined this field (for example, MARKETING), the system looks for DEFAULT group type. If it exists, the system uses this to apply the filtering rules and gives an override to the user stating that the system has used the DEFAULT group type rules. If DEFAULT is not defined, then the system displays an error. |
| 7. | Allow Grp Relation | This field is enabled only when Update Group Relation is marked as Yes. It indicates the group relations that are allowed to be part of a customer group with a specific Group Type . |
| 8. | Allow Relation | This field is enabled only when the Update Relation field is set to Yes. It indicates the real relations that are allowed to be part of a customer group with a specific Group Type . |
| 9. | Sector | It represents the customer sectors that are allowed in a customer group for a specific Group Type . For example, HouseHold allows individuals only and Corporate allows corporate customers only. |
| 10. | Allow Cust Type | This field indicates the customer types that are allowed in a customer group for a specific Group Type (for example, Bank Customer, Bank Customer-KYC Investigate, Nordea Party and so on). |
| 11. | All Pers Ent Status | Indicates the allowed person entity’s statuses in a customer group for a specific Group Type (for example, Party). |
| 12. | Validation Rtn | The bank admin can attach a locally created routine for complex rules to be used when a customer group is created for a particular Group Type . |
| 13. | Aggregated Relation | This field represents the aggregated relation codes and each code must be a valid code in the RELATION application.
